description: This PHP source file defines the 'Voucher' class within the OpenCart e-commerce system, specifically as an extension for calculating and managing voucher totals within the catalog model. It includes methods for getting total voucher discounts, confirming vouchers, and unconfirming vouchers related to customer orders.

classes.name: Voucher
classes.description: Represents a voucher total extension responsible for managing voucher-related discounts within the shopping cart totals.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates and adds the voucher discount to the total if a voucher is set in session; updates totals and total value accordingly.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Confirms the voucher based on order information, applying voucher history entries and handling fraud status.

methods.name: unconfirm
methods.description: Reverses the voucher confirmation by removing voucher history entries associated with the order.
